blind_target.title: Standardizing ADOS Domain Scores: Separating Severity of Social Affect and Restricted and Repetitive Behaviors.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall confirmation of the target domain calibration findings; quantitative sample differences do not negate that verdict.

luna_triage.reason: The paper explicitly replicates the ADOS domain calibrated severity score finding and directly identifies Hus et al. (2014); its reference list gives the target title and DOI. The only shipped original, row 412, is a different Hus and Lord 2014 paper with a different title and DOI (10.1007/s10803-014-2080-3), so it does not represent the cited original (10.1007/s10803-012-1719-1). The retested finding is that calibrated domain scores have reduced associations with child characteristics compared with raw domain totals.
luna_triage.omission_quote: Using a sample of 2,509 probands with ASD from the Simons Simplex Collection (SSC), this study provides the first replication of the ADOS domain CSS in an independent sample.
